protocol.training: 2022-01-01 <= interval; available_at <= 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z; last 2022 day excluded at first decision
protocol.shadow_feedback: Continuous old expert net returns including original costs; available_at = day_end_us + 1 microsecond; no surcharge; not funded subwallets

utility.scale: max(0.001, median training RMS of 7 non-cash streams)

protocol.prior: CASH and HOLD each 1/3; six TREND streams each 1/18; canonical dedup before learning
protocol.static_train_frozen: Best registered single expert by sum(log1p(net return)) on available training feedback, ties original order; finite one-hot domain, no global convex claim
protocol.pressure_feedback: Frozen BASE weight paths; stress changes real wallet and risk only

uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive paired daily excess, no selection adjustment, not independent units/stages

positive_gate.zero_exposure_static_risk_comparison: N/A; use other nonzero predeclared static risk control; CASH only return benchmark

protocol.strong_single_gate: BASE net incremental vs SMA200_SIGNED >=100 USDT in both units; CASH return benchmark via strictly positive net
protocol.round_2_trigger: Only explicit projection/covariance infeasibility or numerical fallback with otherwise positive causal edge permits one same-weight conservative projection ablation; no new pool/ML without evidence. If gate passes with feasible original projection, freeze and seek fresh data rather than add a round.
protocol.stop: No evidence for routing: STATIC_EDGE_ONLY if tradable static is profitable, otherwise NO_NET_EDGE_IN_TESTED_CLASS; missing/incomplete => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. FRESH_OOS_CONFIRMED impossible on seen data.
protocol.old_controls: EQUAL_EXPERTS, STATIC_DIRECTION3 and ORACLE60D retained as original 730-day historical references; never substitute for independently initialized 2023 controls
protocol.optional_ocr: N/A: no same-window actual REGIME_EXPOST wallet; old full-window oracle is incompatible denominator
protocol.direction_scope: BTC signed experts already have both signs; direction budget split and paired carry are not added in first round

run_binding.resource_limits: Actual server resources; no CPU/RAM quota; shared memmap; 15GiB free-disk guard

input_binding.scope: Selected accepted BTC records only; no promotion of overall failed source producer; historical Binance execution proxy
